propositions: A semantic capability registry must validate that every capability references a declared packaging extra and every route's possible capability name exists.
Command execution must enforce semantic capabilities only at selected boundaries after mode/backend selection, not during route discovery or help construction.
Capabilities with error posture must invoke a shared error helper at the chosen enforcement point; unavailable/abstain/fallback postures retain domain component control of payloads and logging.
Stable verbs and top-level help must remain present and functional in a no-extras wheel; only selected capability boundaries emit actionable errors.
Lean diagnostic and read-only modes must execute without requiring sibling live capabilities (e.g., audit show without audit_ui, non-agent review workflows without agent_runtime).
Separate entry points mcp_server and review_bot must consume capability metadata without appearing in the top-level CLI route registry.
